crossRefs.note: But as God is faithful, our word toward you was not “Yes and no.”

The God and Father of the Lord Jesus Christ, he who is blessed forever more, knows that I don’t lie.
For God is my witness, whom I serve in my spirit in the Good News of his Son, how unceasingly I make mention of you…

people.name: Corinth
people.line: Ancient Greek city; recipient of Paul's epistles

translations.web: But I call God for a witness to my soul, that I didn’t come to Corinth to spare you.
translations.bsb: I call God as my witness that it was in order to spare you that I did not return to Corinth.
translations.kjv: Moreover I call God for a record upon my soul, that to spare you I came not as yet unto Corinth.
translations.asv: But I call God for a witness upon my soul, that to spare you I forbare to come unto Corinth.
